content: The Avon Walk for Breast Cancer is a fundraising initiative designed to support the Avon Foundation in its efforts to research and find a cure for breast cancer. Participants in this event are required to raise a minimum of $1,800 to contribute to the cause. Over the course of two days, participants walk distances of either 26.2 miles or 39.3 miles, depending on their chosen challenge. This event was first established in 2003 and is currently held in eight cities across the United States. These cities include Washington, DC; Boston; Chicago; Denver; San Francisco; Los Angeles; New York; and Charlotte. Starting in 2008, Houston, Texas, will also be added as a new host city for the walk. The Houston event is scheduled to take place in early April. In 2006, the Avon Walk for Breast Cancer saw participation from over 22,000 individuals, collectively raising more than $42 million to support breast cancer research and related initiatives.
